$comment: The lua-filter catalogue for the Enhancing Export store. Every filter it lists is vendored in this folder, so the store never depends on a third-party host being up. See README.md for the entry schema and for how to add a filter.

filters.description: Write the abstract as an ordinary "# Abstract" heading instead of squeezing it into the note's properties. The filter lifts that section into the metadata the templates read.
filters.author: Albert Krewinkel

filters.description: Splices whole notes into the document where you name them, so a thesis or a manual can stay a folder of small notes and still export as one file.
filters.author: Albert Krewinkel

filters.description: Fills an empty code block from a file on disk — all of it, or just a range of lines. Code samples in the note can never drift from the code they came from.
filters.author: Bruno Beaufils

filters.description: Turns a \newpage or \pagebreak line in the note into a real page break — in Word, ODT, LaTeX/PDF, EPUB and HTML alike, rather than in LaTeX only.
filters.author: Benct Philip Jonsson, Albert Krewinkel

filters.description: Keeps a block or a span out of the formats it was not written for, so one note can carry both the printed wording and the web wording.
filters.author: Julien Dutant, Albert Krewinkel

filters.description: Write a table as a nested list and have it come out as a table. Cells that hold a paragraph, a list or a code block stay editable in the note instead of becoming an unreadable pipe table.
filters.author: Martin Fischer

filters.description: Passes code-block attributes through to reveal.js, so a slide can highlight lines and step through them.
filters.author: Tim Sokollek

filters.description: Resolves Better BibTeX citekeys against a running Zotero, so citations and the bibliography come out right without exporting a .bib file first.
filters.author: Emiliano Heyns · Better BibTeX
filters.requires: Zotero running, with the Better BibTeX add-on installed.

filters.description: Looks up every DOI you cite and writes the matching bibliography entry for you, so a reference needs nothing but its DOI.
filters.author: Takuro Hosomi
filters.requires: An internet connection at export time.

filters.description: Splits the references into separate lists — sources and software, primary and secondary — from one library, each printed where you put it.
filters.author: Albert Krewinkel

filters.description: Gives every chapter or section its own reference list instead of one long list at the end.
filters.author: Jesse Rosenthal, Albert Krewinkel

filters.description: Writes out a .bib file holding only the entries the document actually cites — what you hand in with a manuscript instead of your whole library.
filters.author: John MacFarlane
filters.requires: The bibexport program, part of TeX Live.

filters.description: Lets a citation record why it is there — agrees with, extends, uses a method from — and can list the sources by that relation.
filters.author: Albert Krewinkel, Robert Winkler

filters.description: Rewrites authors and affiliations into the shape journal templates expect, so a list of names in the note's properties comes out as a proper author list.
filters.author: Albert Krewinkel, Robert Winkler

filters.description: Prints the authors, their affiliations and the corresponding address as a formatted block under the title.
filters.author: Albert Krewinkel
filters.requires: Runs after "Scholarly metadata" — add that filter first.

filters.description: Draws the diagram a code block describes and puts the picture in the document: Mermaid, GraphViz/Dot, PlantUML, TikZ, Asymptote and more.
filters.author: Albert Krewinkel and contributors
filters.requires: The tool for the diagrams you use (mermaid-cli, dot, plantuml, …) on the PATH.

filters.description: Renders TeX formulas to SVG with MathJax, so the maths shows up wherever the file is opened — no MathJax, no fonts, no internet needed by the reader.
filters.author: Serge Y. Stroobandt

filters.description: Gives a figure a short caption for the list of figures, separate from the long one printed underneath it.
filters.author: Greg Tucker-Kellogg

filters.description: The same for tables: a short caption for the list of tables, and a way to keep a table out of that list altogether.
filters.author: Blake Riley

filters.description: Sets \ce{} chemical equations and isotopes written in mhchem notation.
filters.author: John MacFarlane

filters.description: Engraves LilyPond notation written in the note and puts the score in the document as an image.
filters.author: Cole Miller
filters.requires: The lilypond program on the PATH.

filters.description: Replaces plain " and ' with the marks the document's language actually uses — « » in French, „ “ in German, “ ” in English.
filters.author: Odin Kroeger

filters.description: Indents the first line of every paragraph the way books do, and leaves the paragraph that opens a section flush, as typographers set it.
filters.author: Julien Dutant

filters.description: Sets the font, size, colour and alignment of a marked span or section, for the passages a template has no style for.
filters.author: Nandakumar Chandrasekhar

filters.description: Drops the https:// and the trailing slash from a bare link, so an address printed in the text reads as text.
filters.author: Albert Krewinkel

filters.description: Lets inline code in a table cell take its own character style, so it can be sized for the table instead of the body text. Pandoc hardcodes VerbatimChar there and ignores anything else.
filters.author: pan4ratte
filters.requires: A character style named "Table Verbatim" in the reference document.

filters.description: Puts a thin spacer paragraph before and after every table, so tables do not sit flush against the text in Word.
filters.author: pan4ratte

filters.description: Decides what to do with the tracked changes in a .docx you are reading in: accept them, reject them, or keep both readings.
filters.author: Mathias Walter

filters.description: Sets code blocks with LaTeX's minted package, which highlights far more languages, and better, than the plain verbatim pandoc falls back to.
filters.author: Stephen McDowell
filters.requires: Pygments installed, and LaTeX run with --shell-escape.

filters.description: Stops LaTeX breaking a hyphenated word at its hyphen when it justifies a line — the fix for names and compounds split across lines.
filters.author: Frederik Elwert

filters.description: Sets the note as a letter through KOMA-Script's scrlttr2 class, addressee and closing included. No longer maintained upstream.
filters.author: Albert Krewinkel

filters.description: Counts the words pandoc reads, not the characters the file holds — markup, properties and link targets left out. Prints the count instead of exporting.
filters.author: John MacFarlane

filters.description: Lists the misspelled words of a note, reading the prose and skipping code, links and maths. Prints the list instead of exporting.
filters.author: John MacFarlane
filters.requires: The aspell program on the PATH.
